integrity: Exact geometric proof and a standalone finite cross-check are supplied. Finite checks are not an infinite proof. Earlier complete moment formulas are explicitly credited; historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact width survival formula is restricted to the high-width interval [sqrt(2/3),1] for fixed d>=3; no entire distribution, dimension-uniform remainder, statistical inference, or independent external validation is claimed. An equivalent earlier root-system cap computation remains a priority risk.
title: Two sharp spherical-cap transitions in regular-simplex projection widths
